description.text: The major is to train professionals with the basic knowledge of the life science and biotechnology, who are qualified for such position as research, technology development, production management and administration in the area of industry, medicine, food, environmental protection, landscaping, agriculture, forestry, animal husbandry and fishery. The major combines science of information, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and computer in the context of the information technology, forming its own characteristics in research and education. It pays much attention to basic knowledge and practical ability, which results in a three-in-one model of education - teaching, research, and production from the traditional training model. It trains students with a solid theoretical foundation and the pioneering and innovative spirit as well.

duration.text: The Biological Technology at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.High school academic transcript 5.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: With senior high school diploma and HSK certificate of level 4 or above
